name: What is the typical lifespan of laminate flooring?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of laminate flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of laminate flooring varies depending on its quality, the thickness of the wear layer, and the amount of foot traffic it receives. High-quality laminate can last 15-25 years, while some premium options come with warranties up to 30 years or more. Proper installation and maintenance, such as regular cleaning and prompt spill cleanup, significantly contribute to extending its durability. Factors like pet activity and direct sunlight exposure can also influence how long laminate flooring retains its appearance and structural integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Laminate flooring typically lasts 15-25 years, with premium options lasting longer. Durability depends on quality, wear layer thickness, traffic, and maintenance.
